comments: Free public scan, no signup required. Paid plans add scheduled monitoring with alerts, a REST API, CI/workflow integration, and white-label reports agencies can rebrand and resell to clients. Automated testing addresses roughly 30-40% of WCAG success criteria; each result includes prioritized, source-level fix guidance.
features: CompliaScan is an automated WCAG 2.2 accessibility scanner. Paste any URL for a plain-English report in about 30 seconds, powered by axe-core plus custom checks. It flags issues, prioritizes fixes, gives an accessibility score, and exports PDF reports. Covers WCAG 2.2, ADA, Section 508 and EAA.
title: CompliaScan
